purpose: Test whether a hard outcome-blind warm-state admissibility condition on the uncapped V98 band8 LoadLeast substitution removes latency and cost regressions while retaining its throughput and QPR gains over the frozen V94 anchor.

revealed_diagnosis.implementation_gap: The V98 per-player structural choice requires a strictly lower projected task count and a nonworse routed score, but warm affinity is only one soft component of the routed score. It therefore does not hard-prohibit replacing a warm anchor with a cold candidate or require that a lower-load candidate already be warm.
revealed_diagnosis.mechanistic_hypothesis: Load balancing can improve fixed-window completions while still worsening QPR when it introduces cold-container work. A hard warm-state admissibility rule is the narrowest current-state safeguard tied directly to the revealed latency/cost regressions. Returning to the uncapped V98 band8 parent avoids retaining the V99 cap intervention, which was directionally harmful in sustained load.
revealed_diagnosis.causal_limit: Completed requests do not identify which individual structural substitution caused a later latency or cost change. V100 therefore treats warm-preserving and warm-only eligibility as fresh-seed preregistered candidates rather than reconstructing counterfactual outcomes.

closed_alternatives.cap3_or_cap4: not pursued because cap1 and cap2 were both systematically harmful to sustained QPR and the cap response was not monotone
closed_alternatives.scenario_or_burst_label_router: forbidden because workload labels are outside the online information boundary
closed_alternatives.completion_or_QPR_feedback: forbidden because completed-request outcomes and all selection metrics are outside the online information boundary
closed_alternatives.density_retuning: not pursued because beneficial and harmful accepted windows continue to overlap strongly in queue density

allowed_online_inputs: current pending plus resident task count by node
current running warm-container membership for the player function on anchor and candidate nodes
frozen terminal-OCS or nonterminal-FaaSRank routed score and history

arms.warm_admissibility: candidate must be warm whenever the frozen anchor node is warm; cold-anchor substitutions retain exact V98 eligibility
every structurally substituted candidate node must already have a running warm container for the player function

candidate_mechanism.player_order: retain the exact V94 SRPT-ready order
candidate_mechanism.density_band: retain the exact V98 band8 ranges: [8,64) for nonterminal players and [0,64) for terminal players
candidate_mechanism.eligible_move: retain the exact V98 strictly-lower-projected-load and routed-score-nonworse rule, then apply only the arm-specific warm-state condition
complete_initializer_acceptance: at least one warm-admissible structural substitution
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: retain the V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard and additionally require a nonworse complete-assignment LoadLeast score
candidate_mechanism.threshold_provenance: No fitted numeric threshold is introduced. Both candidates use boolean simulator container state already present in the common scheduling snapshot.

selection.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain across all three scenarios and both conventions, then maximize the minimum relative throughput change, then prefer warm-preserve over warm-only, then arm_id
selection.frozen_E4_component: V97 v97-e4-load-guard64; no V100 E4 arm or result-dependent E4 reselection
selection.E3_pass_authorizes_only: a separately committed E906-E925 all-20-seed confirmation plan pairing the selected E3 profile with the already frozen V97 E4 profile
selection.failure_action: Freeze all 27 runs, keep every reserved or confirmation seed untouched, do not replace seeds or selectively rerun scientific results, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
